assets.name: forest-background
assets.prompt: Create ONLY the reusable website background artwork inspired by the attached study UI reference. Remove ALL UI, panels, text, logo, numbers, icons, characters, and books. Delicate hand-painted sage and olive forest foliage and pale tree silhouettes ONLY along far left and right edges, leafy branch at upper right corner, soft meadow with tiny cream daisies and muted yellow-green grasses at bottom edge.
